name: Egberipiribo
description: A multi-skin publishing theme. Ships Fable: a colour rail with the site's sections, a front page that leads deeper, and stories set for long reading.
author: Krafty Sprouts Media, LLC

home-also-today.label: Front page: also today (three stories beside the cover)

home-long-read.label: Front page: the long read (one story in the brand colour)

home-sections.label: Front page: from the sections (up to four featured lists)

home-most-read.label: Front page: most read (a ranked list)

ad-leaderboard.label: Header banner: ad below the top of every page (728 × 90)

ad-in-feed.label: In-feed banner: ad between rows of stories (970 × 250)

settings.label: All skins: which skin draws the site
settings.description: Chooses the skin that draws every page. Only Fable is available in this release, so the setting stays hidden.

settings.label: Ads: show advertisement slots
settings.description: Turn off to hide every advertisement slot at once, without emptying the regions an editor filled.

settings.label: Newsletter: show the sign-up band
settings.description: Turn off to remove the newsletter band and the buttons that point to it.

settings.label: Article byline: show Updated for edited stories
settings.description: Lets a story show an Updated date once it was edited after it was published; turn it off to never show one.

settings.label: Article byline: days before an edit counts as Updated
settings.description: A story shows an Updated date only when it was edited at least this many days after it was published.

settings.label: Comments: show comments on stories
settings.description: Shows the comments and the comment form under stories; turn it off to hide them everywhere.

settings.label: Article byline: show the reading time
settings.description: Shows how many minutes a story takes to read, such as "5 min read".

settings.label: Article: show the tags under the story
settings.description: Shows the "Filed under" tags below a story.

settings.label: Article author card: show the author card
settings.description: Shows a box about each author below the story, when they have a bio or a page.

settings.label: Newsletter: show the band above the footer
settings.description: Shows the dark sign-up band above the footer; off also removes the rail and menu buttons that point to it.

settings.label: Search: open a panel from the search buttons
settings.description: Opens the search panel over the page; off makes the search buttons plain links to the search page.

settings.label: Search: show the "/" key hint and shortcut
settings.description: Shows the "/" hint on the rail's search button and lets readers press the key to open the search.

settings.label: Share: show buttons on articles
settings.description: Shows the share buttons on articles, at the byline and after the tags.

settings.label: Share: Facebook
settings.description: Shows a button that shares the article on Facebook.

settings.label: Share: X
settings.description: Shows a button that shares the article on X.

settings.label: Share: email
settings.description: Shows a button that opens a new email with the article's link.

settings.label: Share: copy link
settings.description: Shows a button that copies the article's link.

settings.label: Share: Pinterest
settings.description: Shows a button that shares the article on Pinterest.

settings.label: Share: LinkedIn
settings.description: Shows a button that shares the article on LinkedIn, for a business or news audience.

settings.label: Share: WhatsApp
settings.description: Shows a button that shares the article on WhatsApp, the main way stories travel on phones in many countries.

settings.label: Share: Telegram
settings.description: Shows a button that shares the article on Telegram.

settings.label: Share: Reddit
settings.description: Shows a button that shares the article on Reddit.

settings.label: Share: the phone's own share sheet
settings.description: Shows a button that opens the phone's own share sheet, only on devices that offer one.

settings.label: Share: where the buttons sit
settings.description: Puts the buttons at the byline, after the tags, in both places or in a floating column beside the article on wide screens.

options.both: At the byline and after the tags

settings.label: Share: button style
settings.description: Shows round icon buttons only, or icons with the name of each network.

settings.label: Share: line before the buttons
settings.description: The line printed before the row of buttons after the tags; leave it empty for none.

settings.label: Pattern: icon set
settings.description: Lays a pattern of small icons over the brand-colour areas; None keeps every area solid.

settings.label: Pattern: how visible the icons are
settings.description: Sets how strongly the icons show against the colour behind them.

settings.label: Pattern: how close the icons sit
settings.description: Sets how tightly the icons repeat: open, even or tight.

settings.label: Pattern: accent colour
settings.description: The colour one icon in seven takes; leave it empty to keep every icon white.

settings.label: Pattern: icon colours
settings.description: Chooses white icons with one accent icon in seven, all accent icons, or all white icons. It needs an accent colour.

settings.label: Pattern: icon layout
settings.description: Scatters and turns the icons, lays them in straight rows, or adds dots between the straight rows.

settings.label: Pattern: icon style
settings.description: Draws the icons as outlines or as solid shapes.

settings.label: Pattern: show on the rail
settings.description: Shows the pattern on the side rail on wide screens.

settings.label: Pattern: show on the phone header
settings.description: Shows the pattern on the header of small screens.

settings.label: Pattern: show on the footer
settings.description: Shows the pattern on the footer.

settings.label: Pattern: show on the home long read
settings.description: Shows the pattern behind the long read block on the home page.

settings.label: Pattern: show on section headings
settings.description: Shows the pattern behind section headings.

settings.label: Pattern: show behind the 404 number
settings.description: Shows the pattern behind the big 404 on the page-not-found screen.

settings.label: Home: show the page title
settings.description: Show the title at the top of the home page. When off, it is hidden from view but kept for screen readers and search engines.

settings.label: Home: show the story count
settings.description: Show "N stories on this page" beside the home page title.

settings.label: Home: show the top stories strip
settings.description: Show the ranked strip of top stories above the home page.

settings.label: Home: top stories strip numbers
settings.description: Show the big number before each headline in the top stories strip.

settings.label: Home: show the cover story
settings.description: Show the cover story with its picture and headline card at the top of the home page.

settings.label: Home: cover story section name
settings.description: Show the section name above the cover story headline.

settings.label: Home: cover story standfirst
settings.description: Show the short summary under the cover story headline.

settings.label: Home: cover story byline
settings.description: Show the author and date under the cover story.

settings.label: Home: show Also today
settings.description: Show the row of small stories under the cover story. When off, the newest stories it would have shown move into the grid.

settings.label: Home: Also today section names
settings.description: Show the section name above each small headline in Also today.

settings.label: Home: Also today pictures
settings.description: Show the small square picture beside each headline in Also today.

settings.label: Home: show the wide ad under Also today
settings.description: Show the wide advertisement spot under Also today. It also needs the site-wide ads switch to be on.

settings.label: Home: show the ad inside the story grid
settings.description: Show the advertisement spot inside the grid of stories. It also needs the site-wide ads switch to be on.

settings.label: Home: show the ad beside Most read
settings.description: Show the box advertisement spot beside Most read. It also needs the site-wide ads switch to be on.

settings.label: Home: show the long read block
settings.description: Show the coloured long read block of the home page.

settings.label: Home: show the story grid
settings.description: Show the More to explore grid of stories, with its page links.

settings.label: Home: story grid layout buttons
settings.description: Let readers switch the story grid between a grid and a list.

settings.label: Home: show From the sections
settings.description: Show the From the sections band of up to four section lists.

settings.label: Home: show Most read
settings.description: Show the Most read list near the bottom of the home page.

settings.label: Home: Most read numbers
settings.description: Show the number beside each story in Most read.

settings.label: Article: show the reading progress bar
settings.description: Shows a thin bar across the top of the page that fills as the reader scrolls down a story.

settings.label: Article: show the breadcrumb
settings.description: Shows the trail of links (Home, section, story) above the headline.

settings.label: Article: show the section name above the headline
settings.description: Shows the story's section above the headline when the breadcrumb is not shown.

settings.label: Article: show the standfirst under the headline
settings.description: Shows the short summary (excerpt) under the headline when the story has one.

settings.label: Article byline: show the author's initials
settings.description: Shows a circle with the lead author's initials beside the byline.

settings.label: Article byline: show the author names
settings.description: Shows "By" and the names of the story's authors in the byline.

settings.label: Article byline: show the publication date
settings.description: Shows the date the story was published in the byline.

settings.label: Article byline: show the Updated date
settings.description: Shows the date a story was updated, after the publication date, when it was changed after publishing.

settings.label: Article hero: show the large picture
settings.description: Shows the story's featured picture, large, under the byline.

settings.label: Article hero: show the caption and credit
settings.description: Shows the picture's caption and credit under the large picture.

settings.label: Article: show custom fields before the text
settings.description: Shows the custom fields you set to appear before the story's text, such as a "Reviewed by" line.

settings.label: Article: show the In this story list
settings.description: Shows a list of the story's headings in the side rail so readers can jump to a part (stories and pages).

settings.label: Article: set the first paragraph larger
settings.description: Sets the first paragraph of a story in larger type, as an introduction.

settings.label: Article: show a Related card inside the text
settings.description: Shows one related story as a small card inside the text, after its second paragraph.

settings.label: Article: show custom fields after the text
settings.description: Shows the custom fields you set to appear after the story's text.

settings.label: Article: show the area under the text
settings.description: Shows the After content area, where you can place a callout, a button or featured posts, under the story.

settings.label: Article ads: show the top banner
settings.description: Shows the wide ad area above the story (the ad-leaderboard region), while ads are on.

settings.label: Article ads: show the ad inside the text
settings.description: Shows the ad area inside the story's text (the ad-in-article region), while ads are on.

settings.label: Article ads: show the ad after the text
settings.description: Shows the second ad area after the story's text (the ad-in-article-2 region), while ads are on.

settings.label: Article ads: show the tall ad beside the story
settings.description: Shows the tall ad area beside the story on screens 1440 pixels wide and up (the ad-half-page region), while ads are on.

settings.label: Article read next: show the Read next strip
settings.description: Shows one related story as a Read next strip after the text.

settings.label: Article read next: show the reason line
settings.description: Shows the small line under the Read next headline that says why the story is suggested.

settings.label: Article author card: show the initials
settings.description: Shows a circle with the author's initials in the author card.

settings.label: Article author card: show the bio
settings.description: Shows the author's bio in the author card.

settings.label: Article author card: show the More from link
settings.description: Shows the "More from ..." link to the author's page in the author card.

settings.label: Article related: show the Keep reading row
settings.description: Shows a row of related stories under the article.

settings.label: Article related: show the All section link
settings.description: Shows the link to the story's whole section at the right of the row's heading.

settings.label: Comments: show the initials circle
settings.description: Shows a circle with the writer's initials beside each comment.

settings.label: Comments: show the Author badge
settings.description: Shows an Author badge on a comment written by one of the story's authors.

settings.label: Page: show the breadcrumb
settings.description: Shows the trail of links above a page's title.

settings.label: Page: show the standfirst under the title
settings.description: Shows the page's short summary under its title when it has one.

settings.label: Page: show the Last updated line
settings.description: Shows when the page was last updated, under its title.

settings.label: Page: show the featured picture
settings.description: Shows the page's featured picture under its title.

settings.label: Page: show custom fields
settings.description: Shows the custom fields you set to appear on a page.

settings.label: Page: set the first paragraph larger
settings.description: Sets the first paragraph of a page in larger type, as an introduction.

settings.label: Page: show the pages under this one
settings.description: Shows a list of the pages that sit under this page.

settings.label: Page: show comments
settings.description: Shows comments under a page, when the page has a comment thread.

settings.label: Archive: show the breadcrumb
settings.description: The trail of links above the section name.

settings.label: Archive: show the kind label
settings.description: The small label (Section, Topic, Writer) above the title.

settings.label: Archive: show the description
settings.description: The section's description under the title.

settings.label: Archive: show the header picture
settings.description: The section's own picture beside the header, when it has one.

settings.label: Archive: show the topic chips
settings.description: The section's topics as chips under the description.

settings.label: Archive: show the All chip
settings.description: The All chip that starts the row of topics.

settings.label: Archive: show advertisements
settings.description: Both advertisement slots on listings; turn off to remove both.

settings.label: Archive: show the leaderboard ad
settings.description: The wide advertisement under the header.

settings.label: Archive: show the ad at the end of the grid
settings.description: The wide advertisement after the last story of the grid.

settings.label: Archive: show the lead story
settings.description: The first story of page 1 set large above the grid.

settings.label: Archive: show the lead standfirst
settings.description: Show the standfirst under the lead story's headline.

settings.label: Archive: show the lead byline
settings.description: Show the byline under the lead story.

settings.label: Archive: show the grid and list buttons
settings.description: Lets the reader switch the stories between a grid and a list.

settings.label: Author: show the breadcrumb
settings.description: The trail of links above the writer's profile.

settings.label: Author: show the portrait
settings.description: The writer's picture, or their initials, beside the name.

settings.label: Author: show the Writer label
settings.description: The small Writer label above the name.

settings.label: Author: show the bio
settings.description: The writer's bio under the name.

settings.label: Author: show the writer's stories
settings.description: The writer's stories as rows under the profile.

settings.label: Search: show the search field
settings.description: The search field under the results heading.

settings.label: Search: show the result count
settings.description: The line that says how many results were found.

settings.label: Search: show the matched passage
settings.description: The passage that matched, with the words marked, under each result.

settings.label: Search: show the section chips
settings.description: Section chips on the empty and no-result pages.

settings.label: Search: show a leaderboard ad
settings.description: A wide advertisement under the search header.

settings.label: Search: show an ad in the results
settings.description: An advertisement at the end of the results list.

settings.label: Not found: show the big 404
settings.description: The large 404 beside the message.

settings.label: Not found: show the search field
settings.description: A search field on the page-not-found page.

settings.label: Not found: show the home button
settings.description: The Go to the home page button.

settings.label: Not found: show the section chips
settings.description: Section chips beside the way home.

settings.label: Error page: show the big number
settings.description: The large status number (403, 429, 500) beside the message.

settings.label: Error page: show the home button
settings.description: The Go to the home page button.

settings.label: Error page: show the search field
settings.description: A search field on error pages.

settings.label: Error page: show the section chips
settings.description: Section chips on error pages.
